name: RizeGreymon
main_effect:
[Your Turn] While you have a suspended Tamer, this Digimon gets +3000 DP and gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.).
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By suspending 1 of your yellow Tamers, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When one of your yellow or red Tamers is deleted, place 1 [Marcus Damon] from your trash on top of your security stack.
